profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | Part-Time Truffle Hunter
profile.summary: Software engineer with a passion for collaboration, learning, and creating user-focused solutions. Before transitioning to tech, I led teams in the marketing pursuit process, honing my ability to view challenges from the customer’s perspective and deliver impactful results. My leadership training with the American Management Association, Dale Carnegie, and Edward Lynx has shaped my approach to building inclusive, high-performing teams. Outside of work, I enjoy hiking with my dog and foraging for Oregon truffles, a hobby that deepens my appreciation for nature and exploration.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Following a strategic realignment, our team took responsibility for supporting five different products, quickly getting up to speed across multiple domains and addressing top customer feature requests.
• Configured Datadog alerts and monitors using Terraform CDKTF, including integrating RUM traces with backend data to enable seamless real-time monitoring.
• Added new features to Time Cards using React and TypeScript, including payroll locking to ensure accurate exports and prevent unauthorized edits, as well as enabling the categorization of employee time across multiple cost codes.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Enhanced backend functionality for EquipmentShare’s T3 Time Cards product by improving export services with Python, AWS SQS, and Lambdas, and optimizing data filtering for performance.
• Transitioned to frontend development for the web and mobile app, implementing features using React, TypeScript and ElasticUI including: security enhancements, user workflow refinements, performance audits, and automated testing.
• Contributed to two greenfield web applications for both fleet and financial management, using Turborepo and Next.js. Developed foundational features, established deployment pipelines, and implemented test coverage requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Developed, deployed, and maintained software solutions to seamlessly connect suppliers with Home Depot Pro customers through the Quote Center application, a critical tool utilized in 2,200+ stores nationwide. 
• Designed and implemented backend microservices using C# and .NET Core, ensuring high performance and scalability. 
• Streamlined deployment processes with Kubernetes, Harness, CircleCI, and SonarCloud, and ensured reliability through proactive monitoring with DataDog.

positions.title: Marketing Manager
positions.description:
• Led marketing strategy sessions to target ideal clients, develop staff, and maintain market relevance to support the Interior Design department. 
• Collaborated with leadership in bi-weekly meetings to track future projects, address staffing needs, and plan upcoming events. 
• Researched and organized software demos to help ZGF explore tools for improving efficiency across the marketing department and company-wide.

positions.title: Senior Marketing Coordinator
positions.description:
• Managed workload for the Portland and Phoenix offices in addition to Marketing Coordinator responsibilities, ensuring balanced resource allocation and seamless workflow.
• Assigned marketing pursuits based on staff availability, organized weekly meetings with marketing and business development teams to align on deliverables, and utilized Salesforce to document and track all pursuits.
• Participated in monthly PR calls for both offices, to ensure that our publications were aligned with our strategic goals.

positions.title: Knowledge Management Coordinator
positions.description:
• Relocated to Stockholm, Sweden, to join the Global Knowledge Management group after completing a global leadership program, contributing to initiatives that enhanced information sharing and collaboration.
• Developed an internal podcast pilot, coordinated international conferences, hosted global webinars, and authored internal news stories to support global knowledge dissemination.
• Collaborated with the Market Making task force to design a roadmap focused on improving customer experience and fostering client loyalty.

positions.title: Marketing Coordinator
positions.description:
• Led multidisciplinary teams—including project executives, schedulers, estimators, and designers—in creating customized proposals for prospective clients.
• Conducted interview preparation for shortlisted teams by designing visual graphics, posing potential client questions, and providing constructive feedback to refine their presentations.
• Photographed over 350 employees across Oregon and California and developed headshot training programs for national marketing meetings.
